description: createDnsRecord: Create a new DNS record for a domain. Requires authentication. For newly registered domains the zone is initialized automatically if missing. Returns the created record including its id for later updates or deletion.

content.description: Record value, e.g. an IPv4 dotted-quad or IPv6 address for A/AAAA, a hostname for CNAME/MX/NS, or text for TXT.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name the record belongs to, e.g. 'example.com'.

name.description: Record name relative to the zone, e.g. 'www', 'mail', or '@' for the apex.

priority.description: Priority for MX/SRV records only; defaults to 0 when omitted.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

ttl.description: Time to live in seconds; defaults to 3600 when omitted.

type.description: Record type: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SRV, CAA.

name: createDnsRecord
